notes: Hudson Republicans elected the county committee in June 2021 and again on the June 10, 2025 primary ballot, where every one of the 467 election districts had a Republican 'For Members of the County Committee (Vote for Two)' contest; the 2026 primary had none. The county's official 2025 results (Clarity and table reports) contain no county committee contests, so no results were found and the evidence is the official sample ballots (a candidate listing). The ballots do not mark which candidate is running for the male or female seat, so seats are labeled 'Member'. Unknown = a slot with a printed Republican candidate (result not verified). Empty_no_filer = no Republican candidate for the slot (write-ins could still have won). 4 districts had more than two candidates (both seats unknown). Candidates were counted from the ballot-position labels in the Republican county committee column of each page; 9 rotated pages (East Newark and Guttenberg) were read from the text layout, where both slots read 'NO PETITION FILED'. Precinct names are as printed in each page's form label (e.g. 'BAYONNE W1 D1').
